name: Dolo
description: A pain reliever used for pain and high temperature.
simple: Paracetamol helps relieve pain and reduce a high temperature.
sideEffects: Side effects are uncommon; allergic reactions can occur.
precautions: Other products can also contain paracetamol. Ask a pharmacist about duplicate ingredients.
Liver or kidney problems may affect suitability.

name: Cetirizine
description: An antihistamine used to relieve allergy symptoms.
simple: Cetirizine blocks histamine, a substance involved in allergy symptoms.
precautions: Sleepiness can affect driving or using machinery.
Kidney problems and other medicines may affect suitability.

name: Omeprazole
description: A proton pump inhibitor that reduces the amount of acid made in the stomach.
simple: Omeprazole reduces stomach acid. It is used for conditions such as heartburn and acid reflux.
precautions: Other medicines can interact with omeprazole.
Persistent or worsening symptoms need a professional assessment.

name: Amoxicillin
description: A penicillin antibiotic used for certain bacterial infections.
simple: Amoxicillin is an antibiotic. Antibiotics do not treat viral illnesses such as colds.
precautions: A previous penicillin allergy is relevant to suitability.

name: Augmentin
description: A combination antibiotic, also called co-amoxiclav, used for certain bacterial infections.
simple: This medicine combines amoxicillin with clavulanic acid. The combination is a different product from amoxicillin alone.
precautions: Penicillin allergy and a history of liver problems are important to discuss with a pharmacist.
